questions.question: Who has authored the book ‘History That India Ignored’, whose new edition was launched by Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Prem Prakash.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant launched the new edition of the book ‘History That India Ignored’, authored by ANI Chairman Prem Prakash.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The book ‘History That India Ignored’ has been authored by veteran journalist and ANI Chairman Prem Prakash.**
 
• The new edition was launched by Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant in Panaji.
 
• The book documents lesser-known and misrepresented chapters of India’s freedom struggle.
 
• History That India Ignored__ 
 __
 
• Covers the sacrifice of unsung freedom fighters
 
• Includes detailed accounts of Veer Savarkar’s life
 
• Highlights the Liberation of Goa and the Battle of Imphal
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Prem Prakash__

 __
 
• Chairman of Asian News International and a veteran journalist.
 
• Author of History That India Ignored, which focuses on overlooked aspects of India’s freedom movement.
 
 
 
• Asian News International__
 __
 
• India’s leading multimedia news agency that provides news to newspapers, television channels and digital platforms.
 
 
 
• Veer Vinayak Damodar Savarkar__
 __
 
• A prominent freedom fighter whose life and sacrifices are detailed in the second edition of the book.
 
 
 
• Liberation of Goa__
 
 
• The process by which Goa was freed from Portuguese rule and integrated into India in 1961.

questions.question:
With reference to the Asia Manufacturing Index 2026, which of the following statements is/are correct?

1) India ranked 6th among 11 Asian economies in the Asia Manufacturing Index 2026 released by Dezan Shira & Associates.

2) Malaysia ranked 1st in the index, followed by China and Vietnam.

options.text: Both statement 1 and statement 2 are incorrect
Both statement 1 and statement 2 are correct

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Only statement 1 is correct.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **India ranked 6th among 11 Asian economies in the Asia Manufacturing Index 2026 released by Dezan Shira & Associates.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **India secured the 6th position out of 11 Asian economies in the Asia Manufacturing Index 2026.**
 
• The index is published by Dezan Shira & Associates.
 
• China ranked 1st, followed by Malaysia and Vietnam.
 
• Statement 2 is incorrect as Malaysia did not top the index.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Asia Manufacturing Index__

 __
 
• An index that evaluates manufacturing competitiveness of Asian economies.
 
• Based on 8 pillars and 43 sub-pillars.
 
• Scores range from 0 to 100, with 100 being the best performance.
 
 
 
• Key Pillars Assessed__
 __
 
• Economy
 
• Political risk
 
• Business environment
 
• International trade
 
• Tax policy
 
• Infrastructure
 
• Workforce
 
• Innovation
 
 
 
• India’s Performance Trend__
 
 
• Ranked 4th in the first Asia Manufacturing Index 2024 among 8 countries.
 
• Fell to 6th position in 2025 when the index expanded to 11 countries.
 
• Strongest pillar for India was Workforce, ranked 1st.

questions.question: The 17th DOSTI Maritime Exercise commenced in January 2026. DOSTI is a trilateral maritime exercise among which of the following countries?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**India, Maldives, Sri Lanka.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The 17th DOSTI Trilateral Maritime Exercise involving India, Maldives, and Sri Lanka began in January 2026 in Male, Maldives.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **DOSTI is a trilateral maritime exercise conducted by India, Maldives, and Sri Lanka.**
 
• **The 17th edition of the exercise commenced in January 2026.**
 
• **The exercise focuses on enhancing regional maritime security and interoperability.**
 
• **It aligns with India’s SAGAR vision and neighborhood-first policy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **DOSTI Maritime Exercise**__

 __
 
• Launched in 1991 as a bilateral exercise between India and Maldives.
 
• Expanded in 2012 to include Sri Lanka, becoming a trilateral exercise.
 
• Aims to address regional maritime challenges and enhance coordination.
 
• Includes harbour and sea phase activities.
 
 
 
• **Key Exercise Components**__
 
 
• MARPOL drills focusing on marine pollution response.
 
• VBSS drills enhancing visit, board, search, and seizure operations.
 
• Strengthens operational synergy among participating navies.

questions.question: Which bank became India’s first Gramin Bank to introduce a solar-powered ATM van?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Tripura Gramin Bank.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Tripura Gramin Bank became the first Gramin Bank in India to introduce a solar-powered ATM van, earning the SKOCH Silver Award.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tripura Gramin Bank launched India’s first solar-powered ATM van among Gramin Banks.**
 
• The initiative supports sustainable and eco-friendly banking services.
 
• The project earned the bank the prestigious SKOCH Silver Award.
 
• The bank currently operates three solar-powered ATM vans across Tripura.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Tripura Gramin Bank__

 __
 
• A regional rural bank operating in Tripura
 
• Has around 150 branches serving rural and remote areas
 
 
 
• Solar-powered ATM Van__
 __
 
• A mobile ATM unit operated using solar energy
 
• Provides uninterrupted banking services in areas with limited electricity
 
 
 
• SKOCH Silver Award__
 __
 
• A national-level award for excellence in governance and innovation
 
• Given by the SKOCH Group
 
 
 
• Financial Inclusion__
 
 
• Ensuring access to banking and financial services for all sections of society
 
• A major objective of Gramin Banks and government initiatives

questions.question: Who was recently conferred with the Sangita Kalanidhi award, considered the highest recognition in Carnatic music in January 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**R.K. Shriramkumar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Violinist R.K. Shriramkumar was conferred with the Sangita Kalanidhi award, the highest recognition for excellence in Carnatic music.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The Sangita Kalanidhi award was instituted in 1942 by the Madras Music Academy.**
 
• Recipients receive a **gold medal and a birudu patra (citation)**.
 
• Since 2005, awardees also receive the **MS Subbulakshmi Award**, instituted by The Hindu.
 
• R.K. Shriramkumar is a renowned violinist recognized for his contribution to Carnatic music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Madras Music Academy__

 __
 
• Founded in 1927 as an offshoot of the All India Congress Session held in Madras.
 
• Organizes annual music and dance festivals and confers awards in Carnatic music.
 
 
 
• M.S. Subbulakshmi__
 __
 
• First Indian musician to receive the Ramon Magsaysay Award in 1974.
 
• First Indian to perform at the United Nations General Assembly in 1966.
 
• First musician awarded the Bharat Ratna in 1998.
 
 
 
• Significance of the Award__
 __
 
• Recognized as the “Nobel Prize” of Carnatic music.
 
• Conferred to honor excellence and lifelong contribution to Carnatic music.
 
 
 
• Other Awards by Music Academy__
 
 
• Sangita Kala Acharya, TTK Award, and Musicologist Awards.
 
• Encourages promotion and preservation of Carnatic music traditions.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding **Bharat Electricity Summit 2026:**

 
• The theme of Bharat Electricity Summit 2026 is “Electrifying Growth. Empowering Sustainability. Connecting Globally”.
 
• The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy has conducted the summit.

Which of the above statements is/are ***correct***?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1 only.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Bharat Electricity Summit 2026 will be held from 19–22 March 2026 in New Delhi with a focus on sustainability, global cooperation and the future of electricity systems.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The theme of Bharat Electricity Summit 2026 is “Electrifying Growth. Empowering Sustainability. Connecting Globally”.**
 
• The Summit is a global conference-cum-exhibition for the power and electricity sector.
 
• It is being organised under the leadership of the Ministry of Power, not the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy.
 
• The event will bring together policymakers, industry leaders, investors and global stakeholders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Ministry of Power__

 __
 
• The nodal ministry responsible for electricity generation, transmission and distribution in India.
 
• It is leading the organisation of Bharat Electricity Summit 2026.
 
 
 
• Bharat Electricity Summit__
 __
 
• A global platform showcasing India’s leadership in energy transition.
 
• It focuses on clean energy, power infrastructure, storage, and smart electricity systems.
 
 
 
• Ministry of New and Renewable Energy__
 __
 
• Responsible for renewable energy development in India.
 
• It is a stakeholder ministry but not the organising authority of the Summit.
 
 
 
• Theme Significance__
 
 
• The theme reflects India’s transition from energy scarcity to energy abundance.
 
• It emphasises sustainability, resilience and global collaboration in electricity systems.

questions.question: The “Operation Milap” initiative launched by the Delhi Police is primarily related to which of the following?

options.text: Monitoring child labour in urban areas
Tracing and reuniting missing children with their families

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Tracing and reuniting missing children with their families.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Delhi Police traced over 1,300 missing persons under “Operation Milap”, aimed at restoring missing children to their families.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Operation Milap is a Delhi Police initiative to reunite missing children with their parents.**
 
• The scheme involves checking children housed in observation homes and child care institutions.
 
• It focuses on identifying children who may have lost contact with their families.
 
• The initiative complements FIR registration and anti-human trafficking measures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Missing Children Scenario in Delhi__

 __
 
• Over 2,100 children were reported missing in Delhi in the referenced year.
 
• A majority of missing children were girls.
 
• Many cases are linked to family disputes, peer pressure and trafficking risks.
 
 
 
• Related Police Initiatives__
 __
 
• Project SNEH for coordination with NGOs and awareness programmes.
 
• Anti-Human Trafficking Units established in all districts.
 
• Pehchaan scheme for photographing children from vulnerable families.
 
 
 
• Operational Significance__
 
 
• Ensures prompt action in missing child cases.
 
• Strengthens child protection mechanisms.
 
• Aims to reduce long-term separation of children from families.

questions.question: The logo unveiled for India’s BRICS Presidency 2026 is inspired by which national symbol of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lotus.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India unveiled the logo and website for its BRICS Presidency 2026, with the logo inspired by the lotus, India’s national flower.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The BRICS Presidency 2026 logo is inspired by the lotus, India’s national flower.**
 
• The centre of the logo shows two hands in a Namaste formed by lotus petals.
 
• The five petals represent the founding BRICS members Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa.
 
• The logo reflects unity, diversity and India’s cultural identity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac06f5ea3da340fcd1dea1341c5fbd14bb21e985ba603b72eced97eb0944077f.png] ​ [IMAGE: https://www.firstpost.com/world/brics-india-logo-launched-jaishankar-bets-on-meeting-shared-challenges-as-new-delhi-assumes-chair-13968122.html] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• BRICS__

 __
 
• The term BRICS is formed from the first letters of its original members, which include Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa, with Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, the UAE and Indonesia joining the grouping as full members at a later stage.
 
• Focuses on cooperation in economic development, finance and global governance
 
 
 
• India’s BRICS Presidency 2026__
 __
 
• India will chair BRICS in 2026
 
• Marks 20 years since the formation of the BRICS grouping
 
 
 
• Namaste Symbol__
 __
 
• A traditional Indian gesture representing respect and unity
 
• Used in the logo to highlight India’s cultural ethos
 
 
 
• BRICS Website__
 
 
• Serves as a central platform for updates, meetings and initiatives during India’s chairship
 
• Facilitates information sharing and global engagement

questions.question: What is the name of the joint-forces military exercise being conducted by the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) countries in Saudi Arabia?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gulf Shield 2026.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Gulf Cooperation Council forces have begun a major joint military exercise titled Gulf Shield 2026 in Saudi Arabia.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The name of the joint-forces exercise is Gulf Shield 2026.**
 
• It involves armed forces from all member states of the Gulf Cooperation Council.
 
• The exercise is being conducted in Saudi Arabia.
 
• Purpose of the Exercise__ 
 __
 
• Enhance combat readiness of GCC forces
 
• Improve joint planning and operational coordination
 
• Strengthen collective defence capabilities
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 __

• Members include Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain and Oman
 
• Promotes security, defence and economic cooperation
 
 
 
• Significance of Gulf Shield 2026__
 
 
• Demonstrates unity among GCC military forces

questions.question: Which Indian state has launched its first Braille library exclusively for visually impaired persons?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh launched the state’s first Braille library for visually impaired persons at DSMNRU, Lucknow.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh unveiled its first Braille library dedicated exclusively to visually impaired persons.**
 
• The facility has been established at Dr Shakuntala Mishra National Rehabilitation University in Lucknow.
 
• The library provides academic and literary resources in Braille to promote inclusive education.
 
• Braille Library Initiative__ 
 __
 
• Supports education and independence of visually impaired students
 
• Aligned with the vision of “education for all”
 
• Encourages accessibility and empowerment
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Dr Shakuntala Mishra National Rehabilitation University__

 __
 
• Located in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh
 
• Dedicated to education and rehabilitation of persons with disabilities
 
• Hosts specialised facilities for inclusive learning
 
 
 
• Braille Script__
 __
 
• Developed by Louis Braille
 
• Used by visually impaired persons for reading and writing
 
• Plays a crucial role in accessible education worldwide
 
 
 
• Inclusive Education__
 
 
• Ensures equal learning opportunities for all students
 
• Focuses on accessibility and assistive technologies
 
• Key component of social empowerment policies
